## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

Whether you’re a graduate student testing a new electrode chemistry or an R&D engineer scaling the
next battery system, you need [carbon nanotubes][69], [graphene][70], and advanced nanomaterials you
can build on — materials with specs that hold and results you can reproduce. For 21 years,
researchers and engineers have chosen our materials for exactly that.

## The Work You Came Here to Do

Your research or product is the work only you can do. The best materials disappear into the
background — doing exactly what the specifications promised — so you can focus on the rest.

When the materials work, your project succeeds. Papers hit their deadlines. Prototypes advance.
Production runs meet their targets. Your best hours go to the questions only you can answer.

## How to Work with Cheap Tubes

### 1. Find what you need.

Browse [100+ products in our catalog][73] — carbon nanotubes ([single-walled][74],
[multi-walled][75], [functionalized][76], [industrial grade][77]), [CVD graphene films][78],
[graphene oxide][79], [graphene nanoplatelets][80], [silver nanowires][81], and more. Each product
page shows full specs, characterization data, and microscopy images. If you don’t see exactly what
you need, [ask us][82]. If we can’t help, we’ll point you in the right direction.

### 2. Buy online or request a quote.

Standard research quantities ship from our catalog. Bulk orders, custom specifications, or
large-volume purchases get a [quote][83] within one business day.

### 3. Ship with full documentation.

Every order includes a Technical Data Sheet (TDS) and [Safety Data Sheet][84]. Typical lead time 2–5
business days from our Townshend, Vermont shipping facility.

## About Cheap Tubes

Cheap Tubes was founded in 2005 by Mike Foley in Townshend, Vermont. Mike needed nanomaterials for
his own work and couldn’t find a supplier who consistently delivered what the specifications
promised. So he built one.

Twenty one years and 10,000+ customers later, we’re still the same team — supplying researchers at
universities, national labs, and R&D groups at companies like MIT, NASA, Rice, Harvard, 3M, and the
US Army. Every order is backed by our published-specs guarantee: if the material doesn’t meet the
spec, we replace it or refund you.

written by the people who make and ship these materials — help you move faster.

## Carbon Nanotube Supplier

Continental Carbon Nanotechnologies, Inc., based in Houston, Texas, is a provider of high quality
Carbon Nanotubes & Carbon Nanotube Blends.

[Carbon Nanotubes][18] represent the next generation of raw materials useful in a wide range of
applications including electrostatic and thermal dissipation, electromagnetic shielding and
composite material constructions. CCNI offers a range of products:
* [Fullerene nanotubes][19] which have smaller diameters and better structural integrity than
  fibrils
* [Multi-wall carbon nanotubes][20] which are an excellent cost and processing compromise
* Classic [single-wall carbon nanotubes][21] manufactured via the HiPco^{™} process
* [Custom blends][22] of CNT and conductive carbon black to suit your unique application


### **Nanotube Manufacturing**

We can provide gram quantities of CNT for research or kilogram quantities for your developing
application. If you are ready to purchase a quality carbon nanotube product, then CCNI is ready to
deliver.

#### **Nanotube Technology**

CCNI employs various manufacturing technologies and industry-leading expertise to produce
high-performance, cost-effective carbon nanotube (products a nanostructured form of the highly
abundant element) for the electronics, energy and materials industries.

##### **Nanotube Properties**

Discovered in the early 1990’s and later pioneered by Nobel Laureate Richard Smalley, CNTs have a
unique structure that gives them extraordinary electrical and mechanical properties, including a
current-carrying capacity per unit area that is one thousand times greater than copper and a tensile
strength that is fifty times greater than steel. Such properties make CNTs a highly promising
material for a wide variety of current and future applications.

###### **Nanotube Applications**

Although CCNI is currently focused on providing tubes to the CNT electronics industry, its grade
slate offerings broadly cover many other promising CNT applications, ranging from structural
composites to sensors to thermal dissipation.

[[carbon black company]][23]

**Interested In Other Carbon Materials?**
CCNI’s affiliate company Continental Carbon Company, a world leading supplier of carbon blacks also
produces other carbon materials such as conductive carbon blacks. These conductive blacks can be
used as-is or custom blended with carbon nanotubes. [Contact us][24] for more information or visit
the [CCC website][25].

[**Carbon Products**][26]

[[technical advice on nanotubes]][27]

**Technical Advice**
CCNI has highly dedicated specialists who can assist with your application. We can offer advice on
blending, dispersions, or selection of the most appropriate grade for your application. [Contact
us][28] for more information.

Discovered in the early 1990’s and later pioneered by Nobel Laureate Richard Smalley, CNTs have a
unique structure that gives them extraordinary electrical and mechanical properties, including a
current-carrying capacity per unit area that is one thousand times greater than copper and a tensile
strength that is fifty times greater than steel. Such properties make CNTs a highly promising
material for a wide variety of current and future applications.

###### **Nanotube Applications**

Although CCNI is currently focused on providing tubes to the CNT electronics industry, its grade
slate offerings broadly cover many other promising CNT applications, ranging from structural
composites to sensors to thermal dissipation.

Carbon Nanotubes & Carbon Nanotube Blends.

[Carbon Nanotubes][18] represent the next generation of raw materials useful in a wide range of
applications including electrostatic and thermal dissipation, electromagnetic shielding and
composite material constructions. CCNI offers a range of products:
* [Fullerene nanotubes][19] which have smaller diameters and better structural integrity than

* [Multi-wall carbon nanotubes][20] which are an excellent cost and processing compromise

# Pioneering the Charge

[
][1]

## Leading the Way for Carbon Nanotube Technology

## Mission

Our tiny technology delivers major impact

##### We are a worldwide leader in carbon nanotubes, a key component of the lithium-ion batteries
##### used to power mobility advanced energy storage for today and tomorrow.
##### 
##### As a global company, we intend to be a good corporate citizen, with a commitment to safety,
##### environmental stewardship, and to the communities where we operate.

[ABOUT US][2]

## Solutions at Scale

The power of X

##### 15,000x thinner than a human hair, 10x to 100x more conductive that typical additives today,
##### and 2x more conductive than pure copper, our carbon nanotube pastes unlock unprecedented gains
##### in battery performance demanded by leading U.S. EV manufacturers as they supply consumers
##### worldwide.

01

### Our U.S.-based production will deliver savings to our customers. 

Major U.S. based EV automakers rely on Cnano USA for their carbon nanotube based conductive battery
materials. The on-shoring of our production at a new facility will reduce the cost to U.S. based EV
manufacturers and the US consumers.

02

### New capabilities that deliver new capacity

As the world leader in carbon nanotube and conductive pastes, Cnano USA is bringing a critical
technology to the U.S. that is not currently available, thereby adding hundreds of American
manufacturing jobs and bolstering the U.S. supply chain.

03

### Specialized manufacturing for a stronger U.S. supply chain

By establishing a major manufacturing center in the U.S., we're not simply enhancing the domestic
supply chain, but rather we are establishing the first CNT production capabilities at the scale
necessary to support the U.S. automotive industry. This also means we are equipping and training a
new generation of American tech workers, and thereby opening the door to American innovation.  

## Doing what we do best

#### Global Leader

Cnano is the leader in the field, producing more CNT based conductive additives than any other
company.

#### Quality & Technology

In the worldwide supply of CNT, Cnano USA is committed to the production of the highest quality CNT
within its facilities.  

#### New U.S. Investment

With our new 300,000 sq. ft. facility Cnano USA will invest over $100 million in plant, equipment,
and employees.

#### New Jobs

Cnano USA’s real investment is with people, creating over 100 new high tech jobs and supporting the
local economy. We have already provided jobs for over 160 people and many more contractors in the
construction of our new facility.

# EMFUTUR Advanced Corporation S.L. is a premier **advanced materials supplier** specialized in
# high-purity carbon nanostructures, functionalized fullerenes, and organic electronics.

## EMFUTUR: Beyond the Future

A premier deep-tech provider of high-purity carbon nanostructures, functionalized fullerenes, and
advanced polymers for electronics, pharmaceuticals, and biotechnology. We deliver validated chemical
solutions at any scale—from milligrams for research to bulk industrial production.

[Our Products][25]
[Get started today][26]
[Discover more][27]

## High-Purity Materials Validated by Global Science

### A Global Advanced Materials Supplier for High-Tech Industries. For over 15 years, we have
### bridged the gap between raw laboratory discovery and industrial-scale manufacturing. Our carbon
### allotropes and specialized polymer matrices are systematically cited in peer-reviewed scientific
### papers and global patents, providing a foundation of absolute batch-to-batch consistency and
### strict Certificate of Analysis (CoA) compliance.

### High-Purity Nanocarbons & Polymers

Our specialized chemical catalog features ultra-pure fullerenes (C60, C70), functionalized
derivatives, and advanced polymers tailored across three strategic industries: organic
optoelectronics (Fullerium™), biomedical R&D (Neurobium™), and high-end dermo-cosmetics (Lumerium™).

### Advanced Matrix Formulation

We provide custom surface functionalization, specialized organic chemical synthesis, and stable
solution dispersions—including bio-compatible water-soluble fullerenols and premium cosmetic-grade
matrices—precisely engineered to fit your strict laboratory or formulation parameters.

# About us

Our team

When you choose us, you choose the manufacturer, bypassing the middleman. Our team consists of
specialists with more than 10 years of practical experience and more than a 100 completed projects.
Many scientific publications in leading Russian and foreign media belong to our employees.

Our company

Our company produces and supplies functional [nanomaterials][34] (nanoparticles and nanopowders) for
the research and development purposes of our customers, participates in the development of new
materials used in various industries.

Scientific research

The development of new products always begins with scientific research. Our specialists are
qualified both for carrying out research and scientific analysis in any field of fundamental
science, as well as introduction of new technologies in production.

## Our products

Nanocyl core business is carbon nanotubes (CNT) production at industrial scale for more than 20
years. NC7000™ powder is the industrial CNT which is used for electrical conductivity or dissipative
behavior for Electronic, Transportation, Energy Storage and Industrial applications. Nanocyl also
developed a strong knowledge and knowhow on its CNT dispersions. Various polymer dispersions are
available on commercial range; into thermoplastics and thermosets (epoxy, rubber, polyol, silicone,
…), and also into liquid media: water and solvent (NMP) for coatings and energy storage
applications.

Please check on “Products” to discover our variety of products and contact us at
technical@nanocyl.com for custom made products, we would be glad to tailor a solution for your
specific needs.

Featured Article: [David Trimble][6]
Lord Trimble official portrait, 2018
**William David Trimble, Baron Trimble,** PC (October 15, 1944 - July 24, 2022), was a politician
from [Northern Ireland][7] who served as leader of the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) and the first
First Minister of Northern Ireland. He shared the 1998 [Nobel Peace Prize][8] with [John Hume][9] of
the Social Democratic and Labour Party. On June 6, 2006, he became a member of the House of Lords as
The Right Honourable William David Trimble by the name, style and title of Baron Trimble, of
Lisnagarvey in the County of Antrim. Although a staunch [Protestant][10] and member of the Orange
Order, Trimble was able to reach across both the religious and the political divide to enter peace
negotiations and to agree a new power-sharing system of governance.
Popular Article: [Ion][11]
The Earth's "plasma fountain," showing [oxygen][12], [helium][13], and [hydrogen][14] ions that gush
into space from regions near the Earth's poles. The faint yellow material above the [North Pole][15]
represents gas lost from Earth into space; the green material is the aurora borealis—or [plasma][16]
energy pouring back into the atmosphere.
